id: title:brandonleung:refuse oauth tokens minted under staff impersonation

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a runtime check in the gateway credential cache to reject OAuth tokens minted by staff impersonation, preventing unauthorized warehouse ingestion spend.
review.reason: The supplied hunk P1.F1.H1 demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it adds a check to reject impersonated OAuth tokens in the gateway credential cache. This is a reliability and security improvement for warehouse ingestion, a critical PostHog product area. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are not supplied, so the complete implementation and test coverage cannot be fully,
review.uncertainty: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied; P2 and P3 are missing, and P1.F2.H1 lacks implementation details. The tier is assigned based on the visible hunk, but the absence of P2 and P3 prevents a complete assessment of the group's systemic impact or test coverage. No tier assignment is possible without P2 and P3.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are provided; no missing context. No relationship between P1 and P3 is established, but P1 and P3 share the same security intent. P2 and P3 are not supplied, so no complete group is available. No tier assignment is possible.
